title: To Live Long, but Not Too Long
coreMove: Improve survival odds first by removing fragility-amplifying inputs rather than adding heroic fixes.
sourcePressure: This chapter applies Via Negativa to longevity through subtraction, restraint, and avoiding avoidable harm.
